D01.quote: It contains only an SVG, so a screen reader announces "button".

D02.quote: The only label is the placeholder, which disappears on typing and is not a reliable accessible name.

D06.quote: Comparison table encodes yes/no by colour only

D07.quote: A positive tabindex jumps FAQ ahead of Pricing, which breaks reading order (WCAG 2.4.3).

D08.quote: Heading levels jump: h1 then h4 (plan names), h2, h3

D10.quote: "Prices are shown per month, billed monthly." is #bbb on white, 1.92:1.

D13.quote: At 390 and 320 px `scrollWidth` is 584 against a 390 or 320 px viewport, so the page scrolls sideways.

D14.quote: Touch targets are about 14 px high.

D15.quote: The text "100 reconciliations per month, one bank connection, CSV and PDF export" is cut at "one ba"

D16.quote: Sticky header is 140 px tall and covers anchor targets

D17.quote: Paddings differ (20, 24, 28 px) and Business has a fixed `height: 380px`.

D18.quote: Feature list items are 12 px, the badge 12 px, the fine print 11 px and the footer links 12 px.

D19.quote: A single 100+ word sentence is set across the full 1230 px width

D20.quote: Georgia, Arial, Comic Sans MS, Courier New and Impact are mixed in one view.

D23.quote: That blames the user and gives no example or next step.

D24.quote: "Perfect Package" is filler and "Package" is capitalised at random, while the page calls them "plans" and "tier" in other places.

D28.quote: The emoji are read aloud ("rocket", "locked", "chart increasing") and render differently per platform.

unlisted.quote: "Most popular" sits on Starter, the cheapest plan, with no visual emphasis
unlisted.why: Badge is on Starter card only, no emphasis; misplaced.

unlisted.quote: The hero lede (#dcd0ff) is 4.04:1 on the purple end of the gradient
unlisted.why: Computed ratio matches; hero lede fails AA on gradient.

unlisted.quote: Annual plans are billed once a year" and "All plans include a trial" conflict
unlisted.why: Fine print mentions annual billing and trial absent elsewhere in plans.

unlisted.quote: The input and button are not in a form element, so Enter does not submit
unlisted.why: Section is not a form element; input and button unwrapped.

unlisted.quote: A "Delete workspace" confirmation sits inline in a pricing page, which is out of context.
unlisted.why: Inline static dialog with no modal behaviour exists in fixture.

unlisted.quote: It also has no JavaScript, so it does nothing
unlisted.why: Close button has no handler; script is only empty toggleCompare.

unlisted.quote: The three plan cards stay in one row.
unlisted.why: Flex row with no responsive rule squashes cards on phones.
Table lacks caption, thead and scope attributes.

unlisted.quote: has no association with the input
unlisted.why: Error paragraphs lack aria-describedby, role alert; real issue.

unlisted.quote: The line also duplicates the list item above it.
unlisted.why: Feature line repeats '100 reconciliations per month' from list.

unlisted.quote: there is no link to the home page
unlisted.why: Logo img is not wrapped in a link.

unlisted.quote: Only two questions, with no billing, cancellation or tax answers
unlisted.why: Subjective content critique, weakly actionable; not a defect in fixture.
